answer: Bonded vouching makes sybils costly: each new agent locks a refundable deposit, and an established peer stakes its own reputation to vouch for it. Cheat once and both are slashed. A swarm of fakes that looks solid is really karst, honeycombed with hidden liability, so one gale of coordinated fraud collapses the whole cavern. The attacker's violet ledger of forfeited stake grows linearly per identity, never free.
